{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_019RZcSkmD7xEJKuG1CbEgLy","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n2\tpragma solidity 0.8.28;\n3\t\n4\timport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n5\timport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n6\timport {Math} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol\";\n7\timport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\n8\timport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n9\timport {ReentrancyGuard} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\n10\t\n11\timport {IAavePool} from \"./interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n12\t\n13\t/// @title UsdtYieldVault\n14\t/// @notice Pooled USDT vault that routes deposits into Aave V3 and tracks\n15\t///         depositor ownership with internal shares.\n16\t/// @dev Shares carry 18 decimals while USDT carries 6, so the first depositor\n17\t///      mints at `SHARE_SCALE`. Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to\n18\t///      the remaining shareholders rather than being swept to the owner.\n19\tcontract UsdtYieldVault is Ownable, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {\n20\t    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n21\t    using Math for uint256;\n22\t\n23\t    /// @notice Denominator for all basis-point maths.\n24\t    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR = 10_000;\n25\t\n26\t    /// @notice Scaling factor between 6-decimal USDT and 18-decimal shares.\n27\t    uint256 public constant SHARE_SCALE = 1e12;\n28\t\n29\t    /// @notice Smallest accepted deposit, in USDT base units (1 USDT).\n30\t    uint256 public constant MIN_DEPOSIT = 1e6;\n31\t\n32\t    /// @notice Fee charged on withdrawal, in basis points.\n33\t    uint256 public constant WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS = 30;\n34\t\n35\t    uint16 private constant AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE = 0;\n36\t\n37\t    /// @notice The underlying asset (USDT).\n38\t    IERC20 public immutable usdt;\n39\t\n40\t    /// @notice The interest-bearing Aave receipt token for `usdt`.\n41\t    IERC20 public immutable aUsdt;\n42\t\n43\t    /// @notice The Aave V3 lending pool deposits are routed through.\n44\t    IAavePool public immutable aavePool;\n45\t\n46\t    /// @notice Fee charged on deposit, in basis points.\n47\t    uint256 public depositFeeBps;\n48\t\n49\t    /// @notice Total shares outstanding across all depositors.\n50\t    uint256 public totalShares;\n51\t\n52\t    /// @notice Vault-tracked USDT supplied to Aave, in USDT base units.\n53\t    uint256 public totalAssetsStored;\n54\t\n55\t    /// @notice Shares held per depositor.\n56\t    mapping(address account => uint256 shares) public shareBalance;\n57\t\n58\t    event Deposited(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n59\t    event Withdrawn(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n60\t    event DepositFeeUpdated(uint256 previousFeeBps, uint256 newFeeBps);\n61\t\n62\t    error AmountBelowMinimum();\n63\t    error NoSharesMinted();\n64\t    error ZeroShares();\n65\t    error InsufficientShares();\n66\t\n67\t    /// @param _usdt The underlying USDT token.\n68\t    /// @param _aUsdt The Aave aUSDT receipt token.\n69\t    /// @param _aavePool The Aave V3 pool.\n70\t    /// @param _depositFeeBps Initial deposit fee in basis points.\n71\t    /// @param initialOwner Address granted ownership.\n72\t    constructor(address _usdt, address _aUsdt, address _aavePool, uint256 _depositFeeBps, address initialOwner)\n73\t        Ownable(initialOwner)\n74\t    {\n75\t        usdt = IERC20(_usdt);\n76\t        aUsdt = IERC20(_aUsdt);\n77\t        aavePool = IAavePool(_aavePool);\n78\t        depositFeeBps = _depositFeeBps;\n79\t    }\n80\t\n81\t    /// @notice Supplies `amount` of USDT into the vault and mints shares to the caller.\n82\t    /// @param amount Amount of USDT to deposit, in base units.\n83\t    /// @return shares Number of shares minted to the caller.\n84\t    function deposit(uint256 amount) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n85\t        if (amount < MIN_DEPOSIT) revert AmountBelowMinimum();\n86\t\n87\t        uint256 fee = (amount * depositFeeBps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n88\t        uint256 netAmount = amount - fee;\n89\t\n90\t        shares = convertToShares(netAmount);\n91\t        if (shares == 0) revert NoSharesMinted();\n92\t\n93\t        usdt.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n94\t        usdt.approve(address(aavePool), amount);\n95\t        aavePool.supply(address(usdt), amount, address(this), AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE);\n96\t\n97\t        totalAssetsStored += amount;\n98\t        totalShares += shares;\n99\t        shareBalance[msg.sender] += shares;\n100\t\n101\t        emit Deposited(msg.sender, amount, shares, fee);\n102\t    }\n103\t\n104\t    /// @notice Burns `shares` and returns the underlying USDT, net of the withdrawal fee.\n105\t    /// @param shares Number of shares to burn.\n106\t    /// @return netAssets USDT sent to the caller, in base units.\n107\t    function withdraw(uint256 shares) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 netAssets) {\n108\t        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n109\t        if (shareBalance[msg.sender] < shares) revert InsufficientShares();\n110\t\n111\t        uint256 grossAssets = convertToAssets(shares);\n112\t        uint256 fee = (grossAssets * WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n113\t        netAssets = grossAssets - fee;\n114\t\n115\t        shareBalance[msg.sender] -= shares;\n116\t        totalShares -= shares;\n117\t        totalAssetsStored -= grossAssets;\n118\t\n119\t        aavePool.withdraw(address(usdt), netAssets, msg.sender);\n120\t\n121\t        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, netAssets, shares, fee);\n122\t    }\n123\t\n124\t    /// @notice Updates the deposit fee.\n125\t    /// @param newFeeBps New deposit fee in basis points.\n126\t    function setDepositFee(uint256 newFeeBps) external onlyOwner {\n127\t        uint256 previousFeeBps = depositFeeBps;\n128\t        depositFeeBps = newFeeBps;\n129\t        emit DepositFeeUpdated(previousFeeBps, newFeeBps);\n130\t    }\n131\t\n132\t    /// @notice Pauses deposits and withdrawals.\n133\t    function pause() external onlyOwner {\n134\t        _pause();\n135\t    }\n136\t\n137\t    /// @notice Resumes deposits and withdrawals.\n138\t    function unpause() external onlyOwner {\n139\t        _unpause();\n140\t    }\n141\t\n142\t    /// @notice USDT currently tracked by the vault, in base units.\n143\t    function totalAssets() public view returns (uint256) {\n144\t        return totalAssetsStored;\n145\t    }\n146\t\n147\t    /// @notice Converts a USDT amount into shares at the current share price.\n148\t    /// @param assets USDT amount in base units.\n149\t    /// @return Shares corresponding to `assets`.\n150\t    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) public view returns (uint256) {\n151\t        if (totalShares == 0) {\n152\t            return assets * SHARE_SCALE;\n153\t        }\n154\t        return assets.mulDiv(totalShares, totalAssetsStored);\n155\t    }\n156\t\n157\t    /// @notice Converts shares into a USDT amount at the current share price.\n158\t    /// @param shares Share amount.\n159\t    /// @return USDT in base units corresponding to `shares`.\n160\t    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view returns (uint256) {\n161\t        if (totalShares == 0) {\n162\t            return shares / SHARE_SCALE;\n163\t        }\n164\t        return shares.mulDiv(totalAssetsStored, totalShares);\n165\t    }\n166\t\n167\t    /// @notice USDT value currently redeemable by `account`, before the withdrawal fee.\n168\t    function balanceOfUnderlying(address account) external view returns (uint256) {\n169\t        return convertToAssets(shareBalance[account]);\n170\t    }\n171\t\n172\t    /// @notice Current share price, expressed as USDT base units per 1e18 shares.\n173\t    function sharePrice() external view returns (uint256) {\n174\t        if (totalShares == 0) return 1e18 / SHARE_SCALE;\n175\t        return totalAssetsStored.mulDiv(1e18, totalShares);\n176\t    }\n177\t}\n178\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9f6217f-6077-4fe7-82ac-39ece15fcbf2","uuid":"8fab69dc-fd97-4231-88db-60f711eec3fb","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:37:10.124Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083652Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/src/UsdtYieldVault.sol","content":"// \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport {Math} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\nimport {ReentrancyGuard} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"./interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @title UsdtYieldVault\n/// @notice Pooled USDT vault that routes deposits into Aave V3 and tracks\n///         depositor ownership with internal shares.\n/// @dev Shares carry 18 decimals while USDT carries 6, so the first depositor\n///      mints at `SHARE_SCALE`. Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to\n///      the remaining shareholders rather than being swept to the owner.\ncontract UsdtYieldVault is Ownable, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n    using Math for uint256;\n\n    /// @notice Denominator for all basis-point maths.\n    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR = 10_000;\n\n    /// @notice Scaling factor between 6-decimal USDT and 18-decimal shares.\n    uint256 public constant SHARE_SCALE = 1e12;\n\n    /// @notice Smallest accepted deposit, in USDT base units (1 USDT).\n    uint256 public constant MIN_DEPOSIT = 1e6;\n\n    /// @notice Fee charged on withdrawal, in basis points.\n    uint256 public constant WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS = 30;\n\n    uint16 private constant AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE = 0;\n\n    /// @notice The underlying asset (USDT).\n    IERC20 public immutable usdt;\n\n    /// @notice The interest-bearing Aave receipt token for `usdt`.\n    IERC20 public immutable aUsdt;\n\n    /// @notice The Aave V3 lending pool deposits are routed through.\n    IAavePool public immutable aavePool;\n\n    /// @notice Fee charged on deposit, in basis points.\n    uint256 public depositFeeBps;\n\n    /// @notice Total shares outstanding across all depositors.\n    uint256 public totalShares;\n\n    /// @notice Vault-tracked USDT supplied to Aave, in USDT base units.\n    uint256 public totalAssetsStored;\n\n    /// @notice Shares held per depositor.\n    mapping(address account => uint256 shares) public shareBalance;\n\n    event Deposited(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n    event DepositFeeUpdated(uint256 previousFeeBps, uint256 newFeeBps);\n\n    error AmountBelowMinimum();\n    error NoSharesMinted();\n    error ZeroShares();\n    error InsufficientShares();\n\n    /// @param _usdt The underlying USDT token.\n    /// @param _aUsdt The Aave aUSDT receipt token.\n    /// @param _aavePool The Aave V3 pool.\n    /// @param _depositFeeBps Initial deposit fee in basis points.\n    /// @param initialOwner Address granted ownership.\n    constructor(address _usdt, address _aUsdt, address _aavePool, uint256 _depositFeeBps, address initialOwner)\n        Ownable(initialOwner)\n    {\n        usdt = IERC20(_usdt);\n        aUsdt = IERC20(_aUsdt);\n        aavePool = IAavePool(_aavePool);\n        depositFeeBps = _depositFeeBps;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Supplies `amount` of USDT into the vault and mints shares to the caller.\n    /// @param amount Amount of USDT to deposit, in base units.\n    /// @return shares Number of shares minted to the caller.\n    function deposit(uint256 amount) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n        if (amount < MIN_DEPOSIT) revert AmountBelowMinimum();\n\n        uint256 fee = (amount * depositFeeBps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n        uint256 netAmount = amount - fee;\n\n        shares = convertToShares(netAmount);\n        if (shares == 0) revert NoSharesMinted();\n\n        usdt.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        usdt.approve(address(aavePool), amount);\n        aavePool.supply(address(usdt), amount, address(this), AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE);\n\n        totalAssetsStored += amount;\n        totalShares += shares;\n        shareBalance[msg.sender] += shares;\n\n        emit Deposited(msg.sender, amount, shares, fee);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Burns `shares` and returns the underlying USDT, net of the withdrawal fee.\n    /// @param shares Number of shares to burn.\n    /// @return netAssets USDT sent to the caller, in base units.\n    function withdraw(uint256 shares) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 netAssets) {\n        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n        if (shareBalance[msg.sender] < shares) revert InsufficientShares();\n\n        uint256 grossAssets = convertToAssets(shares);\n        uint256 fee = (grossAssets * WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n        netAssets = grossAssets - fee;\n\n        shareBalance[msg.sender] -= shares;\n        totalShares -= shares;\n        totalAssetsStored -= grossAssets;\n\n        aavePool.withdraw(address(usdt), netAssets, msg.sender);\n\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, netAssets, shares, fee);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Updates the deposit fee.\n    /// @param newFeeBps New deposit fee in basis points.\n    function setDepositFee(uint256 newFeeBps) external onlyOwner {\n        uint256 previousFeeBps = depositFeeBps;\n        depositFeeBps = newFeeBps;\n        emit DepositFeeUpdated(previousFeeBps, newFeeBps);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pauses deposits and withdrawals.\n    function pause() external onlyOwner {\n        _pause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Resumes deposits and withdrawals.\n    function unpause() external onlyOwner {\n        _unpause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice USDT currently tracked by the vault, in base units.\n    function totalAssets() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return totalAssetsStored;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Converts a USDT amount into shares at the current share price.\n    /// @param assets USDT amount in base units.\n    /// @return Shares corresponding to `assets`.\n    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) {\n            return assets * SHARE_SCALE;\n        }\n        return assets.mulDiv(totalShares, totalAssetsStored);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Converts shares into a USDT amount at the current share price.\n    /// @param shares Share amount.\n    /// @return USDT in base units corresponding to `shares`.\n    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) {\n            return shares / SHARE_SCALE;\n        }\n        return shares.mulDiv(totalAssetsStored, totalShares);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice USDT value currently redeemable by `account`, before the withdrawal fee.\n    function balanceOfUnderlying(address account) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return convertToAssets(shareBalance[account]);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Current share price, expressed as USDT base units per 1e18 shares.\n    function sharePrice() external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) return 1e18 / SHARE_SCALE;\n        return totalAssetsStored.mulDiv(1e18, totalShares);\n    }\n}\n","numLines":178,"startLine":1,"totalLines":178}}}

SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\ncontract UsdtYieldVaultTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n    MockAavePool public pool;\n    MockAToken public aUsdt;\n\n    address public owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address public alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address public bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 public constant INITIAL_FEE_BPS = 10;\n    uint256 public constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), INITIAL_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              CONSTRUCTOR\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.usdt()), address(usdt));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsAUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.aUsdt()), address(aUsdt));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsAavePool() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.aavePool()), address(pool));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsOwner() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), owner);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsDepositFee() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), INITIAL_FEE_BPS);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                               CONSTANTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_BpsDenominator() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR(), 10_000);\n    }\n\n    function test_ShareScale() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.SHARE_SCALE(), 1e12);\n    }\n\n    function test_MinDeposit() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawFeeBps() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS(), 30);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                DEPOSIT\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_DepositMintsShares() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalShares() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalAssets() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositTransfersUsdtFromDepositor() public {\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositSuppliesToAave() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.Deposited(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, 999e18, 1e6);\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_SecondDepositorMintsShares() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(bob), shares);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_DepositBelowMinimum() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.AmountBelowMinimum.selector);\n        vault.deposit(1e6 - 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                WITHDRAW\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_WithdrawReturnsUsdt() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 netAssets = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(netAssets, 997e6);\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore + 997e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawBurnsShares() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawEmitsEvent() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.Withdrawn(alice, 997e6, shares, 3e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n    }\n\n    function test_PartialWithdraw() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares / 2);\n\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), shares / 2);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_WithdrawZeroShares() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.ZeroShares.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(0);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_WithdrawExceedsBalance() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.InsufficientShares.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares + 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                  FEES\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeUpdatesValue() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), 25);\n    }\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(false, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.DepositFeeUpdated(INITIAL_FEE_BPS, 25);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n    }\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeToZero() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(0);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 1_000e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerSetsDepositFee() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                 PAUSING\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_PauseBlocksDeposit() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_UnpauseRestoresDeposit() public {\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.unpause();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerPauses() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.pause();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                  VIEWS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_TotalAssetsStartsAtZero() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_SharePriceStartsAtOneUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083652Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/.claude/skills/testing\n\n# Smart Contract Testing\n\n## What You Probably Got Wrong\n\n**You test getters and trivial functions.** Testing that `name()` returns the name is worthless. Test edge cases, failure modes, and economic invariants — the things that lose money when they break.\n\n**You don't fuzz.** `forge test` finds the bugs you thought of. Fuzzing finds the ones you didn't. If your contract does math, fuzz it. If it handles user input, fuzz it. If it moves value, definitely fuzz it.\n\n**You don't fork-test.** If your contract calls Uniswap, Aave, or any external protocol (verified addresses: `addresses/SKILL.md`), test against their real deployed contracts on a fork. Mocking them hides integration bugs that only appear with real state.\n\n**You write tests that mirror the implementation.** Testing that `deposit(100)` sets `balance[user] = 100` is tautological — you're testing that Solidity assignments work. Test properties: \"after deposit and withdraw, user gets their tokens back.\" Test invariants: \"total deposits always equals contract balance.\"\n\n**You skip invariant testing for stateful protocols.** If your contract has multiple interacting functions that change state over time (vaults, AMMs, lending), you need invariant tests. Unit tests check one path; invariant tests check that properties hold across thousands of random sequences.\n\n---\n\n## Unit Testing with Foundry\n\n### Test File Structure\n\n```solidity\n// test/MyContract.t.sol\n// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {MyToken} from \"../src/MyToken.sol\";\n\ncontract MyTokenTest is Test {\n    MyToken public token;\n    address public alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address public bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        token = new MyToken(\"Test\", \"TST\", 1_000_000e18);\n        // Give alice some tokens for testing\n        token.transfer(alice, 10_000e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_TransferUpdatesBalances() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        token.transfer(bob, 1_000e18);\n\n        assertEq(token.balanceOf(alice), 9_000e18);\n        assertEq(token.balanceOf(bob), 1_000e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_TransferEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(true, true, false, true);\n        emit Transfer(alice, bob, 500e18);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        token.transfer(bob, 500e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_TransferExceedsBalance() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        token.transfer(bob, 999_999e18); // More than alice has\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_TransferToZeroAddress() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        token.transfer(address(0), 100e18);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### Key Assertion Patterns\n\n```solidity\n// Equality\nassertEq(actual, expected);\nassertEq(actual, expected, \"descriptive error message\");\n\n// Comparisons\nassertGt(a, b);   // a > b\nassertGe(a, b);   // a >= b\nassertLt(a, b);   // a < b\nassertLe(a, b);   // a <= b\n\n// Approximate equality (for math with rounding)\nassertApproxEqAbs(actual, expected, maxDelta);\nassertApproxEqRel(actual, expected, maxPercentDelta); // in WAD (1e18 = 100%)\n\n// Revert expectations\nvm.expectRevert();                           // Any revert\nvm.expectRevert(\"Insufficient balance\");     // Specific message\nvm.expectRevert(MyContract.CustomError.selector); // Custom error\n\n// Event expectations\nvm.expectEmit(true, true, false, true);      // (topic1, topic2, topic3, data)\nemit MyEvent(expectedArg1, expectedArg2);\n```\n\n### What to Actually Test\n\n```solidity\n// ✅ TEST: Edge cases that lose money\nfunction test_TransferZeroAmount() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_TransferEntireBalance() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_TransferToSelf() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_ApproveOverwrite() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_TransferFromWithExactAllowance() public { /* ... */ }\n\n// ✅ TEST: Access control\nfunction test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerCallsAdminFunction() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_OwnerCanPause() public { /* ... */ }\n\n// ✅ TEST: Failure modes\nfunction test_RevertWhen_DepositZero() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_RevertWhen_WithdrawMoreThanDeposited() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_RevertWhen_ContractPaused() public { /* ... */ }\n\n// ❌ DON'T TEST: OpenZeppelin internals\n// function test_NameReturnsName() — they already tested this\n// function test_SymbolReturnsSymbol() — waste of time\n// function test_DecimalsReturns18() — it does, trust it\n```\n\n---\n\n## Fuzz Testing\n\nFoundry automatically fuzzes any test function with parameters. Instead of testing one value, it tests hundreds of random values.\n\n### Basic Fuzz Test\n\n```solidity\n// Foundry calls this with random amounts\nfunction testFuzz_DepositWithdrawRoundtrip(uint256 amount) public {\n    // Bound input to valid range\n    amount = bound(amount, 1, token.balanceOf(alice));\n\n    uint256 balanceBefore = token.balanceOf(alice);\n\n    vm.startPrank(alice);\n    token.approve(address(vault), amount);\n    vault.deposit(amount, alice);\n    vault.withdraw(vault.balanceOf(alice), alice, alice);\n    vm.stopPrank();\n\n    // Property: user gets back what they deposited (minus any fees)\n    assertGe(token.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - 1); // Allow 1 wei rounding\n}\n```\n\n### Bounding Inputs\n\n```solidity\n// bound() is preferred over vm.assume() — bound reshapes, assume discards\nfunction testFuzz_Fee(uint256 amount, uint256 feeBps) public {\n    amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 1e30);       // Reasonable token amounts\n    feeBps = bound(feeBps, 1, 10_000);       // 0.01% to 100%\n\n    uint256 fee = (amount * feeBps) / 10_000;\n    uint256 afterFee = amount - fee;\n\n    // Property: fee + remainder always equals original\n    assertEq(fee + afterFee, amount);\n}\n\n// vm.assume() discards inputs — use sparingly\nfunction testFuzz_Division(uint256 a, uint256 b) public {\n    vm.assume(b > 0); // Skip zero (would revert)\n    // ...\n}\n```\n\n### Run with More Iterations\n\n```bash\n# Default: 256 runs\nforge test\n\n# More thorough: 10,000 runs\nforge test --fuzz-runs 10000\n\n# Set in foundry.toml for CI\n# [fuzz]\n# runs = 1000\n```\n\n---\n\n## Fork Testing\n\nTest your contract against real deployed protocols on a mainnet fork. This catches integration bugs that mocks can't.\n\n### Basic Fork Test\n\n```solidity\ncontract SwapTest is Test {\n    // Real mainnet addresses — full verified list: addresses/SKILL.md\n    address constant UNISWAP_ROUTER = 0x68b3465833fb72A70ecDF485E0e4C7bD8665Fc45;\n    address constant WETH = 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2;\n    address constant USDC = 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        // Fork mainnet at a specific block for reproducibility\n        vm.createSelectFork(\"mainnet\", 19_000_000);\n    }\n\n    function test_SwapETHForUSDC() public {\n        address user = makeAddr(\"user\");\n        vm.deal(user, 1 ether);\n\n        vm.startPrank(user);\n\n        // Build swap path\n        ISwapRouter.ExactInputSingleParams memory params = ISwapRouter\n            .ExactInputSingleParams({\n                tokenIn: WETH,\n                tokenOut: USDC,\n                fee: 3000,\n                recipient: user,\n                amountIn: 0.1 ether,\n                amountOutMinimum: 0, // In production, NEVER set to 0\n                sqrtPriceLimitX96: 0\n            });\n\n        // Execute swap\n        uint256 amountOut = ISwapRouter(UNISWAP_ROUTER).exactInputSingle{value: 0.1 ether}(params);\n\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        // Verify we got USDC back\n        assertGt(amountOut, 0, \"Should receive USDC\");\n        assertGt(IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(user), 0);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### When to Fork-Test\n\n- **Always:** Any contract that calls an external protocol (Uniswap, Aave, Chainlink)\n- **Always:** Any contract that handles tokens with quirks (USDT, fee-on-transfer, rebasing)\n- **Always:** Any contract that reads oracle prices\n- **Never:** Pure logic contracts with no external calls — use unit tests\n\n### Running Fork Tests\n\n```bash\n# Fork from RPC URL\nforge test --fork-url https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_KEY\n\n# Fork at specific block (reproducible)\nforge test --fork-url https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_KEY --fork-block-number 19000000\n\n# Set in foundry.toml to avoid CLI flags\n# [rpc_endpoints]\n# mainnet = \"${MAINNET_RPC_URL}\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## Invariant Testing\n\nInvariant tests verify that properties hold across thousands of random function call sequences. Essential for stateful protocols.\n\n### What Are Invariants?\n\nInvariants are properties that must ALWAYS be true, no matter what sequence of actions users take:\n\n- \"Total supply equals sum of all balances\" (ERC-20)\n- \"Total deposits equals total shares times share price\" (vault)\n- \"x * y >= k after every swap\" (AMM)\n- \"User can always withdraw what they deposited\" (escrow)\n\n### Basic Invariant Test\n\n```solidity\ncontract VaultInvariantTest is Test {\n    MyVault public vault;\n    IERC20 public token;\n    VaultHandler public handler;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        token = new MockERC20(\"Test\", \"TST\", 18);\n        vault = new MyVault(token);\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, token);\n\n        // Tell Foundry which contract to call randomly\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    // This runs after every random sequence\n    function invariant_TotalAssetsMatchesBalance() public view {\n        assertEq(\n            vault.totalAssets(),\n            token.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            \"Total assets must equal actual balance\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    function invariant_SharePriceNeverZero() public view {\n        if (vault.totalSupply() > 0) {\n            assertGt(vault.convertToAssets(1e18), 0, \"Share price must never be zero\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Handler: guided random actions\ncontract VaultHandler is Test {\n    MyVault public vault;\n    IERC20 public token;\n\n    constructor(MyVault _vault, IERC20 _token) {\n        vault = _vault;\n        token = _token;\n    }\n\n    function deposit(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1, 1e24);\n        deal(address(token), msg.sender, amount);\n\n        vm.startPrank(msg.sender);\n        token.approve(address(vault), amount);\n        vault.deposit(amount, msg.sender);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 shares) public {\n        uint256 maxShares = vault.balanceOf(msg.sender);\n        if (maxShares == 0) return;\n        shares = bound(shares, 1, maxShares);\n\n        vm.prank(msg.sender);\n        vault.redeem(shares, msg.sender, msg.sender);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### Running Invariant Tests\n\n```bash\n# Default depth (15 calls per sequence, 256 sequences)\nforge test\n\n# Deeper exploration\nforge test --fuzz-runs 1000\n\n# Configure in foundry.toml\n# [invariant]\n# runs = 512\n# depth = 50\n```\n\n---\n\n## What NOT to Test\n\n- **OpenZeppelin internals.** Don't test that `ERC20.transfer` works. It's been audited by dozens of firms and used by thousands of contracts. Test YOUR logic on top of it.\n- **Solidity language features.** Don't test that `require` reverts or that `mapping` stores values. The compiler works.\n- **Every getter.** If `name()` returns the name you passed to the constructor, that's not a test — it's a tautology.\n- **Happy path only.** The happy path probably works. Test the unhappy paths: what happens with zero? Max uint? Unauthorized callers? Reentrancy?\n\n**Focus your testing effort on:** Custom business logic, mathematical operations, integration points with external protocols, access control boundaries, and economic edge cases.\n\n---\n\n## Pre-Deploy Test Checklist\n\n- [ ] All custom logic has unit tests with edge cases\n- [ ] Zero amounts, max uint, empty arrays, self-transfers tested\n- [ ] Access control verified — unauthorized calls revert\n- [ ] Fuzz tests on all mathematical operations (minimum 1000 runs)\n- [ ] Fork tests for every external protocol integration\n- [ ] Invariant tests for stateful protocols (vaults, AMMs, lending)\n- [ ] Events verified with `expectEmit`\n- [ ] Gas snapshots taken with `forge snapshot` to catch regressions\n- [ ] Static analysis with `slither .` — no high/medium findings unaddressed\n- [ ] All tests pass: `forge test -vvv`\n"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9f6217f-6077-4fe7-82ac-39ece15fcbf2","uuid":"e57c244e-7c67-49fe-8291-54718694ca06","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:38:12.716Z","isSynthetic":true}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGEaARWYihTxhiSeHTM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_014xmWdQQ6f9AMkjJ7D1pUDJ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083652Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/test/fork/RealMainnetIntegration.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Fork tests against the exact mainnet addresses this vault is meant to\n///         ship against. Nothing is mocked: real USDT, real Aave V3 pool, real aUSDT.\ncontract RealMainnetIntegrationTest is Test {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    // Addresses taken verbatim from README.md / the shipping plan.\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n    address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n\n    // Same Aave pool, but an asset whose approve() returns a bool. Used as the\n    // control group so we can separate \"USDT is special\" from \"Aave is broken\".\n    address internal constant USDC = 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48;\n    address internal constant AUSDC = 0x98C23E9d8f34FEFb1B7BD6a91B7FF122F4e16F5c;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        // Override with your own endpoint via MAINNET_RPC_URL if this one rate-limits.\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://eth.drpc.org\")), FORK_BLOCK);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  ROOT CAUSE: real USDT.approve() returns no return data\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Real USDT's approve() has no return value. A plain `IERC20.approve`\n    ///         call therefore fails ABI decoding and reverts.\n    function test_F1_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        (bool okUsdt, bytes memory retUsdt) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, 1));\n        console.log(\"USDT.approve  succeeded:\", okUsdt);\n        console.log(\"USDT.approve  returndata bytes:\", retUsdt.length);\n\n        (bool okUsdc, bytes memory retUsdc) = USDC.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, 1));\n        console.log(\"USDC.approve  succeeded:\", okUsdc);\n        console.log(\"USDC.approve  returndata bytes:\", retUsdc.length);\n\n        assertTrue(okUsdt, \"raw USDT approve should not revert\");\n        assertEq(retUsdt.length, 0, \"USDT returns nothing\");\n        assertEq(retUsdc.length, 32, \"a compliant token returns a bool\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice This is line 94 of UsdtYieldVault.sol, in isolation.\n    function test_F1_TypedApproveOnRealUsdtReverts() public {\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        IERC20(USDT).approve(AAVE_POOL, 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  CONSEQUENCE: deposit() is unusable on mainnet\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Every deposit into the vault as configured for Monday reverts.\n    function test_F2_DepositAlwaysRevertsWithRealUsdt() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDT).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n\n        console.log(\"alice USDT balance:\", IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice));\n        console.log(\"vault allowance   :\", IERC20(USDT).allowance(alice, address(vault)));\n\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        // Nothing moved: the vault holds no position at all.\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Control group: identical vault bytecode, identical Aave pool, but an\n    ///         asset with a compliant approve(). It works. So the fault is the USDT\n    ///         integration in src/, not the Aave integration.\n    function test_F2_SameVaultWorksWithCompliantToken() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        console.log(\"shares minted            :\", shares);\n        console.log(\"vault aUSDC balance      :\", IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console.log(\"vault totalAssetsStored  :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  Aave interest is never credited to depositors\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault ignores its aToken balance, so a year of Aave interest is\n    ///         invisible to depositors and unreachable by anyone.\n    function test_F3_AaveInterestIsNeverCreditedAndIsStranded() public {\n        // Run on USDC so a deposit can actually land (see F-2). The accounting code\n        // under test is identical and asset-agnostic.\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 aTokenBefore = IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        uint256 aTokenAfter = IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"--- after 365 days in Aave ---\");\n        console.log(\"aToken balance before      :\", aTokenBefore);\n        console.log(\"aToken balance after       :\", aTokenAfter);\n        console.log(\"interest actually earned   :\", aTokenAfter - aTokenBefore);\n        console.log(\"vault.totalAssets()        :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console.log(\"alice balanceOfUnderlying  :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        console.log(\"vault.sharePrice()         :\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        // Aave really did pay interest.\n        assertGt(aTokenAfter, aTokenBefore, \"Aave paid interest\");\n\n        // The vault's books did not move one base unit.\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 10_000e6, \"totalAssets is frozen at the deposited amount\");\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), 10_000e6, \"alice's claim never grows\");\n\n        // Alice exits with everything she owns and receives none of the interest.\n        uint256 before = IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n        uint256 received = IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(alice) - Nothing is mocked: real USDT, real Aave V3 pool, real aUSDT.\ncontract RealMainnetIntegrationTest is Test {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    // Addresses taken verbatim from README.md / the shipping plan.\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n    address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n\n    // Same Aave pool, but an asset whose approve() returns a bool. Used as the\n    // control group so we can separate \"USDT is special\" from \"Aave is broken\".\n    address internal constant USDC = 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48;\n    address internal constant AUSDC = 0x98C23E9d8f34FEFb1B7BD6a91B7FF122F4e16F5c;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        // Override with your own endpoint via MAINNET_RPC_URL if this one rate-limits.\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://eth.drpc.org\")), FORK_BLOCK);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  ROOT CAUSE: real USDT.approve() returns no return data\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Real USDT's approve() has no return value. A plain `IERC20.approve`\n    ///         call therefore fails ABI decoding and reverts.\n    function test_F1_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        (bool okUsdt, bytes memory retUsdt) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, 1));\n        console.log(\"USDT.approve  succeeded:\", okUsdt);\n        console.log(\"USDT.approve  returndata bytes:\", retUsdt.length);\n\n        (bool okUsdc, bytes memory retUsdc) = USDC.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, 1));\n        console.log(\"USDC.approve  succeeded:\", okUsdc);\n        console.log(\"USDC.approve  returndata bytes:\", retUsdc.length);\n\n        assertTrue(okUsdt, \"raw USDT approve should not revert\");\n        assertEq(retUsdt.length, 0, \"USDT returns nothing\");\n        assertEq(retUsdc.length, 32, \"a compliant token returns a bool\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice This is line 94 of UsdtYieldVault.sol, in isolation.\n    function test_F1_TypedApproveOnRealUsdtReverts() public {\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        IERC20(USDT).approve(AAVE_POOL, 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  CONSEQUENCE: deposit() is unusable on mainnet\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Every deposit into the vault as configured for Monday reverts.\n    function test_F2_DepositAlwaysRevertsWithRealUsdt() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDT).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n\n        console.log(\"alice USDT balance:\", IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice));\n        console.log(\"vault allowance   :\", IERC20(USDT).allowance(alice, address(vault)));\n\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        // Nothing moved: the vault holds no position at all.\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Control group: identical vault bytecode, identical Aave pool, but an\n    ///         asset with a compliant approve(). It works. So the fault is the USDT\n    ///         integration in src/, not the Aave integration.\n    function test_F2_SameVaultWorksWithCompliantToken() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        console.log(\"shares minted            :\", shares);\n        console.log(\"vault aUSDC balance      :\", IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console.log(\"vault totalAssetsStored  :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  Aave interest is never credited to depositors\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault ignores its aToken balance, so a year of Aave interest is\n    ///         invisible to depositors and unreachable by anyone.\n    function test_F3_AaveInterestIsNeverCreditedAndIsStranded() public {\n        // Run on USDC so a deposit can actually land (see F-2). The accounting code\n        // under test is identical and asset-agnostic.\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 aTokenBefore = IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        uint256 aTokenAfter = IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"--- after 365 days in Aave ---\");\n        console.log(\"aToken balance before      :\", aTokenBefore);\n        console.log(\"aToken balance after       :\", aTokenAfter);\n        console.log(\"interest actually earned   :\", aTokenAfter - aTokenBefore);\n        console.log(\"vault.totalAssets()        :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console.log(\"alice balanceOfUnderlying  :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        console.log(\"vault.sharePrice()         :\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        // Aave really did pay interest.\n        assertGt(aTokenAfter, aTokenBefore, \"Aave paid interest\");\n\n        // The vault's books did not move one base unit.\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 10_000e6, \"totalAssets is frozen at the deposited amount\");\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), 10_000e6, \"alice's claim never grows\");\n\n        // Alice exits with everything she owns and receives none of the interest.\n        uint256 before = IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n        uint256 received = IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(alice) - before;\n\n        console.log(\"--- alice exits with all shares ---\");\n        console.log(\"USDC received              :\", received);\n        console.log(\"USDC deposited             :\", uint256(10_000e6));\n        console.log(\"vault totalShares now      :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console.log(\"vault totalAssetsStored now:\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console.log(\"aUSDC left in vault        :\", IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertLt(received, 10_000e6, \"she gets back less than she put in, after a year of yield\");\n\n        // Vault is now empty on its own books, yet still holds a real Aave position\n        // that no code path can ever reach.\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n        assertGt(IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"stranded forever\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

Nothing is mocked: real USDT, real Aave V3 pool, real aUSDT.\ncontract RealMainnetIntegrationTest is Test {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    // Addresses taken verbatim from README.md / the shipping plan.\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n    address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n\n    // Same Aave pool, but an asset whose approve() returns a bool. A plain `IERC20.approve`\n    ///         call therefore fails ABI decoding and reverts.\n    function test_F1_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        (bool okUsdt, bytes memory retUsdt) = The vault's books claim more than it actually holds.","+    function test_F6_LedgerOverstatesTheRealAavePosition() public {","+        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);","+","+        deal(USDC, alice, 100_000e6);","+        vm.startPrank(alice);","+        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);","+","+        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 5; i++) {","+            vault.deposit(1_000e6);","+            console.log(\"deposit\", i + 1);","+            console.log(\"  totalAssetsStored :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());","+            console.log(\"  real aUSDC held   :\", IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)));","+        }","+        vm.stopPrank();","+","+        assertGt(","+            vault.totalAssetsStored(),","+            IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)),","+            \"ledger claims more than the vault holds\"","+        );","+    }","+","+    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////","         F-2  CONSEQUENCE: deposit() is unusable on mainnet","     //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGQkTLGU8QBvyp1zPxH","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018gaikMFV5CB9ijqVfVcUgf","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083652Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/test/props/VaultAccounting.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"../mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"../mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Accounting properties, checked against the team's own mocks so there is\n///         no argument about the test rig. Every test here asserts the behaviour of\n///         src/UsdtYieldVault.sol exactly as committed.\ncontract VaultAccountingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    /// @dev Zero deposit fee so the withdrawal fee is the only moving part.\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 0, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address who, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(who);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Value the vault really controls in Aave, minus value its ledger accounts for.\n    function _unaccountedValue() internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vault.totalAssetsStored();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-4  The withdrawal fee does not accrue to anybody\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README.md and the contract natspec both state that the withdrawal fee\n    ///         \"stays supplied in Aave and accrues to the remaining shareholders\".\n    ///         It does not: `totalAssetsStored -= grossAssets` removes the fee from the\n    ///         ledger at the same time it leaves the cash behind.\n    function test_F4_WithdrawFeeDoesNotAccrueToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n        uint256 bobShares = _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 bobClaimBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        uint256 bobClaimAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 priceAfter = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        console.log(\"alice paid a withdrawal fee of :\", uint256(3e6));\n        console.log(\"bob's claim before             :\", bobClaimBefore);\n        console.log(\"bob's claim after              :\", bobClaimAfter);\n        console.log(\"share price before             :\", priceBefore);\n        console.log(\"share price after              :\", priceAfter);\n        console.log(\"fee sitting in Aave, unowned   :\", _unaccountedValue());\n\n        // The documented behaviour would be bobClaimAfter == bobClaimBefore + 3e6.\n        assertEq(bobClaimAfter, bobClaimBefore, \"bob gains nothing from alice's fee\");\n        assertEq(priceAfter, priceBefore, \"share price is unchanged\");\n\n        // The money is real, it is in Aave, and no share entitles anyone to it.\n        assertEq(_unaccountedValue(), 3e6, \"3 USDT is now owned by no one\");\n        assertEq(bobShares, vault.shareBalance(bob));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-5  Everything left behind is permanently unrecoverable\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Once every shareholder exits, the vault still holds an Aave position\n    ///         and there is no code path — for a user, or for the owner — to reach it.\n    function test_F5_FundsAreStrandedAfterAllHoldersExit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n        _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(bob));\n\n        console.log(\"totalShares            :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console.log(\"totalAssetsStored      :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console.log(\"aUSDT still held       :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console.log(\"loose USDT in vault    :\", usdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"no shares outstanding\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0, \"ledger says the vault is empty\");\n        assertGt(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"but it is not empty\");\n\n        // There is no rescue/sweep function. The only caller-reachable path into\n        // aavePool.withdraw is UsdtYieldVault.withdraw, which requires shares, and\n        // the only way to obtain shares is to deposit fresh money.\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(bob), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(0), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The leak is not a fixed cost: it scales with the money that flows through.\n    function testFuzz_F5_StrandedValueGrowsWithEveryWithdrawal(uint256 amount, uint8 rounds) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 10_000e6);\n        rounds = uint8(bound(rounds, 1, 20));\n\n        uint256 expectedStranded;\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rounds; i++) {\n            _deposit(alice, amount);\n            uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n            uint256 gross = vault.convertToAssets(shares);\n            expectedStranded += (gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR();\n\n            vm.prank(alice);\n            vault.withdraw(shares);\n        }\n\n        assertEq(_unaccountedValue(), expectedStranded, \"every fee ever charged is still sitting there\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n        assertGt(_unaccountedValue(), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A depositor who never interacts with anyone else still loses the fees,\n    ///         and the vault keeps them rather than paying them to the owner or the pool.\n    function testFuzz_F4_RoundTripLosesFeesToNobody(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, amount);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n        uint256 lost = before - usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        // Whatever the depositor lost is exactly what is now unowned in Aave.\n        assertEq(lost, _unaccountedValue(), \"user's loss == unowned balance\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-7  withdraw() accepts share amounts worth zero assets\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice There is no check that `grossAssets` or `netAssets` is non-zero, so a\n    ///         withdrawal can burn shares and pay out nothing. On the mocks it succeeds\n    ///         silently; see the fork test for what real Aave does with amount == 0.\n    function test_F7_DustWithdrawBurnsSharesForZeroAssets() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 sharesBefore = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 usdtBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        // 1e12 - 1 shares is strictly less than one USDT base unit at this share price.\n        uint256 dust = 1e12 - 1;\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(dust), 0, \"worth zero assets\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 netAssets = vault.withdraw(dust);\n\n        console.log(\"shares burned  :\", sharesBefore - vault.shareBalance(alice));\n        console.log(\"assets received:\", netAssets);\n\n        assertEq(netAssets, 0, \"paid nothing\");\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), usdtBefore, \"received nothing\");\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), sharesBefore - dust, \"but the shares are gone\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The withdrawal fee rounds down to zero for any exit below 334 base units,\n    ///         so the fee is not charged uniformly.\n    function testFuzz_F7_WithdrawFeeRoundsToZeroOnSmallExits(uint256 gross) public view {\n        gross = bound(gross, 1, 333);\n        assertEq((gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR(), 0, \"no fee charged\");\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1221,"cache_read_input_tokens":70687,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1221},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9f6217f-6077-4fe7-82ac-39ece15fcbf2","uuid":"60246849-9866-4c82-9c6e-e8313702cce7","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:44:24.914Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGQiqLz528xW92ppQ9h"}

   }\n\n    function _deposit(address who, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(who);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Value the vault really controls in Aave, minus value its ledger accounts for.\n    function _unaccountedValue() internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vault.totalAssetsStored();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-4  The withdrawal fee does not accrue to anybody\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README.md and the contract natspec both state that the withdrawal fee\n    ///         \"stays supplied in Aave and accrues to the remaining shareholders\".\n    ///         It does not: `totalAssetsStored -= grossAssets` removes the fee from the\n    ///         ledger at the same time it leaves the cash behind.\n    function test_F4_WithdrawFeeDoesNotAccrueToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n        uint256 bobShares = _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 bobClaimBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        uint256 bobClaimAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 priceAfter = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        console.log(\"alice paid a withdrawal fee of :\", uint256(3e6));\n        console.log(\"bob's claim before             :\", bobClaimBefore);\n        console.log(\"bob's claim after              :\", bobClaimAfter);\n        console.log(\"share price before             :\", priceBefore);\n        console.log(\"share price after              :\", priceAfter);\n        console.log(\"fee sitting in Aave, unowned   :\", _unaccountedValue());\n\n        // The documented behaviour would be bobClaimAfter == bobClaimBefore + 3e6.\n        assertEq(bobClaimAfter, bobClaimBefore, \"bob gains nothing from alice's fee\");\n        assertEq(priceAfter, priceBefore, \"share price is unchanged\");\n\n        // The money is real, it is in Aave, and no share entitles anyone to it.\n        assertEq(_unaccountedValue(), 3e6, \"3 USDT is now owned by no one\");\n        assertEq(bobShares, vault.shareBalance(bob));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-5  Everything left behind is permanently unrecoverable\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Once every shareholder exits, the vault still holds an Aave position\n    ///         and there is no code path — for a user, or for the owner — to reach it.\n    function test_F5_FundsAreStrandedAfterAllHoldersExit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n        _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(bob));\n\n        console.log(\"totalShares            :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console.log(\"totalAssetsStored      :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console.log(\"aUSDT still held       :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console.log(\"loose USDT in vault    :\", usdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"no shares outstanding\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0, \"ledger says the vault is empty\");\n        assertGt(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"but it is not empty\");\n\n        // There is no rescue/sweep function. The only caller-reachable path into\n        // aavePool.withdraw is UsdtYieldVault.withdraw, which requires shares, and\n        // the only way to obtain shares is to deposit fresh money.\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(bob), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(0), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The leak is not a fixed cost: it scales with the money that flows through.\n    function testFuzz_F5_StrandedValueGrowsWithEveryWithdrawal(uint256 amount, uint8 rounds) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 10_000e6);\n        rounds = uint8(bound(rounds, 1, 20));\n\n        uint256 expectedStranded;\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rounds; i++) {\n            _deposit(alice, amount);\n            uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n            uint256 gross = vault.convertToAssets(shares);\n            expectedStranded += (gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR();\n\n            vm.prank(alice);\n            vault.withdraw(shares);\n        }\n\n        assertEq(_unaccountedValue(), expectedStranded, \"every fee ever charged is still sitting there\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n        assertGt(_unaccountedValue(), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A depositor who never interacts with anyone else still loses the fees,\n    ///         and the vault keeps them rather than paying them to the owner or the pool.\n    function testFuzz_F4_RoundTripLosesFeesToNobody(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, amount);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n        uint256 lost = before - usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        // Whatever the depositor lost is exactly what is now unowned in Aave.\n        assertEq(lost, _unaccountedValue(), \"user's loss == unowned balance\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-7  withdraw() accepts share amounts worth zero assets\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice There is no check that `grossAssets` or `netAssets` is non-zero, so a\n    ///         withdrawal can burn shares and pay out nothing. On the mocks it succeeds\n    ///         silently; see the fork test for what real Aave does with amount == 0.\n    function test_F7_DustWithdrawBurnsSharesForZeroAssets() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 sharesBefore = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 usdtBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        // 1e12 - 1 shares is strictly less than one USDT base unit at this share price.\n        uint256 dust = 1e12 - 1;\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(dust), 0, \"worth zero assets\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 netAssets = vault.withdraw(dust);\n\n        console.log(\"shares burned  :\", sharesBefore - vault.shareBalance(alice));\n        console.log(\"assets received:\", netAssets);\n\n        assertEq(netAssets, 0, \"paid nothing\");\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), usdtBefore, \"received nothing\");\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), sharesBefore - dust, \"but the shares are gone\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The withdrawal fee rounds down to zero for any exit below 334 base units,\n    ///         so the fee is not charged uniformly.\n    function testFuzz_F7_WithdrawFeeRoundsToZeroOnSmallExits(uint256 gross) public view {\n        gross = bound(gross, 1, 333);\n        assertEq((gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR(), 0, \"no fee charged\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

assertEq(bobShares, vault.shareBalance(bob));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-5  Everything left behind is permanently unrecoverable\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Once every shareholder exits, the vault still holds an Aave position\n    ///         and there is no code path — On the mocks it succeeds\n    ///         silently; see the fork test for what real Aave does with amount == 0.\n    function test_F7_DustWithdrawBurnsSharesForZeroAssets() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 sharesBefore = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 usdtBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        // 1e12 - 1 shares is strictly less than one USDT base unit at this share price.\n        uint256 dust = 1e12 - 1;\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(dust), 0, \"worth zero assets\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 netAssets = vault.withdraw(dust);\n\n        console.log(\"shares burned  :\", sharesBefore - vault.shareBalance(alice));\n        console.log(\"assets received:\", netAssets);\n\n        assertEq(netAssets, 0, \"paid nothing\");\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), usdtBefore, \"received nothing\");\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), sharesBefore - dust, \"but the shares are gone\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The withdrawal fee rounds down to zero for any exit below 334 base units,\n    ///         so the fee is not charged uniformly.\n    function testFuzz_F7_WithdrawFeeRoundsToZeroOnSmallExits(uint256 gross) public view {\n        gross = bound(gross, 1, 333);\n        assertEq((gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR(), 0, \"no fee charged\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":60,"oldLines":8,"newStart":60,"newLines":9,"lines":["         uint256 bobClaimBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);","         uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();"," ","+        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);","         vm.prank(alice);","-        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));","+        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);"," ","         uint256 bobClaimAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);","         uint256 priceAfter = vault.sharePrice();"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}
