Every test here asserts the behaviour of\n///         src/UsdtYieldVault.sol exactly as committed.\ncontract VaultAccountingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    /// @dev Zero deposit fee so the withdrawal fee is the only moving part.\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 0, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address who, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(who);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Value the vault really controls in Aave, minus value its ledger accounts for.\n    function _unaccountedValue() internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vault.totalAssetsStored();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-4  The withdrawal fee does not accrue to anybody\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README.md and the contract natspec both state that the withdrawal fee\n    ///         \"stays supplied in Aave and accrues to the remaining shareholders\".\n    ///         It does not: `totalAssetsStored -= grossAssets` removes the fee from the\n    ///         ledger at the same time it leaves the cash behind.\n    function test_F4_WithdrawFeeDoesNotAccrueToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n        uint256 bobShares = _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 bobClaimBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 bobClaimAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n        uint256 priceAfter = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        console.log(\"alice paid a withdrawal fee of :\", uint256(3e6));\n        console.log(\"bob's claim before             :\", bobClaimBefore);\n        console.log(\"bob's claim after              :\", bobClaimAfter);\n        console.log(\"share price before             :\", priceBefore);\n        console.log(\"share price after              :\", priceAfter);\n        console.log(\"fee sitting in Aave, unowned   :\", _unaccountedValue());\n\n        // The documented behaviour would be bobClaimAfter == bobClaimBefore + 3e6.\n        assertEq(bobClaimAfter, bobClaimBefore, \"bob gains nothing from alice's fee\");\n        assertEq(priceAfter, priceBefore, \"share price is unchanged\");\n\n        // The money is real, it is in Aave, and no share entitles anyone to it.\n        assertEq(_unaccountedValue(), 3e6, \"3 USDT is now owned by no one\");\n        assertEq(bobShares, vault.shareBalance(bob));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-5  Everything left behind is permanently unrecoverable\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Once every shareholder exits, the vault still holds an Aave position\n    ///         and there is no code path — for a user, or for the owner — to reach it.\n    function test_F5_FundsAreStrandedAfterAllHoldersExit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n        _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(bob));\n\n        console.log(\"totalShares            :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console.log(\"totalAssetsStored      :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console.log(\"aUSDT still held       :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console.log(\"loose USDT in vault    :\", usdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"no shares outstanding\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0, \"ledger says the vault is empty\");\n        assertGt(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"but it is not empty\");\n\n        // There is no rescue/sweep function. The only caller-reachable path into\n        // aavePool.withdraw is UsdtYieldVault.withdraw, which requires shares, and\n        // the only way to obtain shares is to deposit fresh money.\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(bob), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(0), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The leak is not a fixed cost: it scales with the money that flows through.\n    function testFuzz_F5_StrandedValueGrowsWithEveryWithdrawal(uint256 amount, uint8 rounds) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 10_000e6);\n        rounds = uint8(bound(rounds, 1, 20));\n\n        uint256 expectedStranded;\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rounds; i++) {\n            _deposit(alice, amount);\n            uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n            uint256 gross = vault.convertToAssets(shares);\n            expectedStranded += (gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR();\n\n            vm.prank(alice);\n            vault.withdraw(shares);\n        }\n\n        assertEq(_unaccountedValue(), expectedStranded, \"every fee ever charged is still sitting there\");\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n        assertGt(_unaccountedValue(), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A depositor who never interacts with anyone else still loses the fees,\n    ///         and the vault keeps them rather than paying them to the owner or the pool.\n    function testFuzz_F4_RoundTripLosesFeesToNobody(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, amount);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n        uint256 lost = before - usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        // Whatever the depositor lost is exactly what is now unowned in Aave.\n        assertEq(lost, _unaccountedValue(), \"user's loss == unowned balance\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-7  withdraw() accepts share amounts worth zero assets\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice There is no check that `grossAssets` or `netAssets` is non-zero, so a\n    ///         withdrawal can burn shares and pay out nothing. On the mocks it succeeds\n    ///         silently; see the fork test for what real Aave does with amount == 0.\n    function test_F7_DustWithdrawBurnsSharesForZeroAssets() public {\n        _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 sharesBefore = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 usdtBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        // 1e12 - dust, \"but the shares are gone\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The withdrawal fee rounds down to zero for any exit below 334 base units,\n    ///         so the fee is not charged uniformly.\n    function testFuzz_F7_WithdrawFeeRoundsToZeroOnSmallExits(uint256 gross) public view {\n        gross = bound(gross, 1, 333);\n        assertEq((gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR(), 0, \"no fee charged\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":93,"oldLines":10,"newStart":93,"newLines":12,"lines":["         _deposit(alice, 1_000e6);","         _deposit(bob, 1_000e6);"," ","+        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);","+        uint256 bobShares = vault.shareBalance(bob);","         vm.prank(alice);","-        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));","+        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);","         vm.prank(bob);","-        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(bob));","+        vault.withdraw(bobShares);"," ","         console.log(\"totalShares            :\", vault.totalShares());","         console.log(\"totalAssetsStored      :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGX58AAJEtNE3jtRCuH","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01R9up4zk1QY2myiaWwJe4h7","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083652Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/test/props/OwnerPowers.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"../mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"../mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice What the owner key can do to depositors. Nothing here exploits a bug in\n///         the sense of \"the code does not do what it says\" — it is what the code\n///         says, and it is why the owner key is worth as much as the TVL.\ncontract OwnerPowersTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal victim = makeAddr(\"victim\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 0, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(owner, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(victim, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-8  setDepositFee has no upper bound\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A fee above 100% makes `amount - fee` underflow, so every deposit\n    ///         reverts with an arithmetic panic until the owner reverses it.\n    function test_F8_FeeAbove100PercentBricksDeposits() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), 10_001, \"accepted without complaint\");\n\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        vm.expectRevert(stdError.arithmeticError);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Exactly 100% is accepted too; deposits then revert as NoSharesMinted.\n    function test_F8_FeeOf100PercentBricksDeposits() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_000);\n\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.NoSharesMinted.selector);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Any bps value at all is accepted, including nonsensical ones.\n    function testFuzz_F8_AnyFeeIsAccepted(uint256 feeBps) public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(feeBps);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), feeBps);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-9  The deposit fee is a transfer from new depositors to\n             existing ones, and the owner can be an existing one\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The deposit fee is credited to `totalAssetsStored` while minting shares\n    ///         only on the net amount, so it enriches whoever already holds shares. With\n    ///         no cap on the fee, the owner can seed one deposit, raise the fee, and take\n    ///         essentially the whole of the next deposit.\n    function test_F9_OwnerCanConfiscateIncomingDeposits() public {\n        // 1. Owner seeds the vault while the fee is zero.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        uint256 ownerShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        console.log(\"owner staked            :\", uint256(1_000e6));\n\n        // 2. Owner raises the fee to 99.99%. Takes effect on the very next transaction.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        // 3. Victim's pending deposit lands.\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        uint256 victimShares = vault.deposit(100_000e6);\n\n        console.log(\"victim deposited        :\", uint256(100_000e6));\n        console.log(\"victim can now redeem   :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(victim));\n        console.log(\"owner can now redeem    :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner));\n\n        // 4. Owner exits with the proceeds.\n        uint256 ownerBefore = usdt.balanceOf(owner);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.withdraw(ownerShares);\n        uint256 ownerProfit = usdt.balanceOf(owner) - ownerBefore;\n\n        console.log(\"owner withdrew          :\", ownerProfit);\n        console.log(\"owner net profit        :\", ownerProfit - 1_000e6);\n\n        assertGt(ownerProfit, 90_000e6, \"owner walks away with the victim's money\");\n        assertLt(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(victim), 2_000e6, \"victim keeps ~1% of a 100k deposit\");\n        assertGt(victimShares, 0);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-10  pause() freezes exits, and can be made permanent\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `withdraw` is `whenNotPaused`, so the pause switch is a freeze on user\n    ///         funds, not just a stop on new deposits.\n    function test_F10_PauseBlocksWithdrawals() public {\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Ownable exposes renounceOwnership. Pause, then renounce, and there is no\n    ///         longer any address on earth that can unpause the vault.\n    function test_F10_PauseThenRenounceFreezesFundsForever() public {\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0), \"no owner remains\");\n\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        // Nobody can lift it, including the old owner.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, owner));\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        console.log(\"victim's frozen principal:\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(victim));\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(victim), 1_000e6);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":900,"cache_read_input_tokens":79395,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":900},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9f6217f-6077-4fe7-82ac-39ece15fcbf2","uuid":"1ac7309a-b55f-4865-9c0c-9c3ff80cbd8f","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:45:30.554Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGX3RDWPWUyqeGmABHq"}

deposits then revert as NoSharesMinted.\n    function test_F8_FeeOf100PercentBricksDeposits() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_000);\n\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.NoSharesMinted.selector);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Any bps value at all is accepted, including nonsensical ones.\n    function testFuzz_F8_AnyFeeIsAccepted(uint256 feeBps) public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(feeBps);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), feeBps);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-9  The deposit fee is a transfer from new depositors to\n             existing ones, and the owner can be an existing one\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The deposit fee is credited to `totalAssetsStored` while minting shares\n    ///         only on the net amount, so it enriches whoever already holds shares. With\n    ///         no cap on the fee, the owner can seed one deposit, raise the fee, and take\n    ///         essentially the whole of the next deposit.\n    function test_F9_OwnerCanConfiscateIncomingDeposits() public {\n        // 1. Owner seeds the vault while the fee is zero.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        uint256 ownerShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        console.log(\"owner staked            :\", uint256(1_000e6));\n\n        // 2. Owner raises the fee to 99.99%. Takes effect on the very next transaction.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        // 3. Victim's pending deposit lands.\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        uint256 victimShares = vault.deposit(100_000e6);\n\n        console.log(\"victim deposited        :\", uint256(100_000e6));\n        console.log(\"victim can now redeem   :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(victim));\n        console.log(\"owner can now redeem    :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner));\n\n        // 4. Owner exits with the proceeds.\n        uint256 ownerBefore = usdt.balanceOf(owner);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.withdraw(ownerShares);\n        uint256 ownerProfit = usdt.balanceOf(owner) - ownerBefore;\n\n        console.log(\"owner withdrew          :\", ownerProfit);\n        console.log(\"owner net profit        :\", ownerProfit - 1_000e6);\n\n        assertGt(ownerProfit, 90_000e6, \"owner walks away with the victim's money\");\n        assertLt(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(victim), 2_000e6, \"victim keeps ~1% of a 100k deposit\");\n        assertGt(victimShares, 0);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-10  pause() freezes exits, and can be made permanent\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice `withdraw` is `whenNotPaused`, so the pause switch is a freeze on user\n    ///         funds, not just a stop on new deposits.\n    function test_F10_PauseBlocksWithdrawals() public {\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Ownable exposes renounceOwnership. Pause, then renounce, and there is no\n    ///         longer any address on earth that can unpause the vault.\n    function test_F10_PauseThenRenounceFreezesFundsForever() public {\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0), \"no owner remains\");\n\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        // Nobody can lift it, including the old owner.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, owner));\n        vault.unpause();\n\n        console.log(\"victim's frozen principal:\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(victim));\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(victim), 1_000e6);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":7,"newStart":1,"newLines":7,"lines":[" // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT"," pragma solidity 0.8.28;"," ","-import {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";","+import {Test, console, stdError} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";"," import {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";"," import {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGb3T4E3KbaGFg7MaZP","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01D2FJRc2Hdh7uqoacR2Cy85","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083652Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/test/invariant/VaultInvariants.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"../mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"../mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Drives the vault with random deposit/withdraw sequences from four actors.\ncontract VaultHandler is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n    MockAToken public aUsdt;\n\n    address[4] public actors;\n\n    // Ghost variables: what a correct implementation would be tracking.\n    uint256 public ghostDeposited;\n    uint256 public ghostWithdrawn;\n    uint256 public ghostWithdrawFees;\n\n    constructor(UsdtYieldVault _vault, MockUSDT _usdt, MockAToken _aUsdt) {\n        vault = _vault;\n        usdt = _usdt;\n        aUsdt = _aUsdt;\n        actors = [makeAddr(\"a0\"), makeAddr(\"a1\"), makeAddr(\"a2\"), makeAddr(\"a3\")];\n    }\n\n    function _actor(uint256 seed) internal view returns (address) {\n        return actors[seed % actors.length];\n    }\n\n    function deposit(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 amount) public {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n\n        usdt.mint(actor, amount);\n        vm.startPrank(actor);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), amount);\n        try vault.deposit(amount) {\n            ghostDeposited += amount;\n        } catch {}\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 sharesSeed) public {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        uint256 balance = vault.shareBalance(actor);\n        if (balance == 0) return;\n\n        uint256 shares = bound(sharesSeed, 1, balance);\n        uint256 gross = vault.convertToAssets(shares);\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256 net) {\n            ghostWithdrawn += net;\n            ghostWithdrawFees += gross - net;\n        } catch {}\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sum of every actor's redeemable claim on the vault.\n    function totalUserClaims() public view returns (uint256 total) {\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            total += vault.balanceOfUnderlying(actors[i]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sum of every actor's share balance.\n    function totalUserShares() public view returns (uint256 total) {\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            total += vault.shareBalance(actors[i]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice The invariant suite the vault does not currently have.\n///\n///         Two of these hold and two do not. The two that hold are worth stating,\n///         because they rule out the failure mode people assume first (a bank run) —\n///         the vault is over-collateralised, not under. The two that fail are the\n///         value leak: money the vault holds that no share can ever claim.\ncontract VaultInvariantsTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n    VaultHandler internal handler;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 0, address(this));\n\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, usdt, aUsdt);\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        THESE HOLD — and should\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault can always honour every claim on its books. No bank run.\n    function invariant_A_VaultIsSolvent() public view {\n        assertGe(\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            vault.totalAssetsStored(),\n            \"vault holds less than its ledger promises\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Share bookkeeping is internally consistent.\n    function invariant_B_SharesAreConserved() public view {\n        assertEq(handler.totalUserShares(), vault.totalShares(), \"share accounting drifted\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                       THESE FAIL — and should not\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Every base unit the vault holds should be claimable by some shareholder.\n    ///         It is not: withdrawal fees accumulate outside the ledger.\n    function invariant_C_NoValueIsUnowned() public view {\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 owned = vault.totalAssetsStored();\n        assertEq(held, owned, \"value in the vault that no share can claim\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice README.md: fees \"accrue to the remaining shareholders\". If that were\n    ///         true, the sum of user claims would track the real Aave position.\n    function invariant_D_UserClaimsMatchRealHoldings() public view {\n        assertEq(\n            handler.totalUserClaims(),\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            \"users cannot collectively claim what the vault actually holds\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    function invariant_CallSummary() public view {\n        console.log(\"deposited      :\", handler.ghostDeposited());\n        console.log(\"withdrawn      :\", handler.ghostWithdrawn());\n        console.log(\"fees charged   :\", handler.ghostWithdrawFees());\n        console.log(\"aUSDT held     :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console.log(\"ledger says    :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console.log(\"user claims sum:\", handler.totalUserClaims());\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":752,"cache_read_input_tokens":84767,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":752},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9f6217f-6077-4fe7-82ac-39ece15fcbf2","uuid":"cb8101ef-e5ae-4746-bdd3-440c4f6a2792","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:46:22.252Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGb2PonPcWP5CezpVbu"}

total) {\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            total += vault.balanceOfUnderlying(actors[i]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sum of every actor's share balance.\n    function totalUserShares() public view returns (uint256 total) {\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            total += vault.shareBalance(actors[i]);\n        }\n The two that fail are the\n///         value leak: money the vault holds that no share can ever claim.\ncontract VaultInvariantsTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n    VaultHandler internal handler;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 0, address(this));\n\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, usdt, aUsdt);\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        THESE HOLD — and should\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault can always honour every claim on its books. No bank run.\n    function invariant_A_VaultIsSolvent() public view {\n        assertGe(\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            vault.totalAssetsStored(),\n            \"vault holds less than its ledger promises\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Share bookkeeping is internally consistent.\n    function invariant_B_SharesAreConserved() public view {\n        assertEq(handler.totalUserShares(), vault.totalShares(), \"share accounting drifted\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                       THESE FAIL — and should not\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Every base unit the vault holds should be claimable by some shareholder.\n    ///         It is not: withdrawal fees accumulate outside the ledger.\n    function invariant_C_NoValueIsUnowned() public view {\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 owned = vault.totalAssetsStored();\n        assertEq(held, owned, \"value in the vault that no share can claim\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice README.md: fees \"accrue to the remaining shareholders\". If that were\n    ///         true, the sum of user claims would track the real Aave position.\n    function invariant_D_UserClaimsMatchRealHoldings() public view {\n        assertEq(\n            handler.totalUserClaims(),\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            \"users cannot collectively claim what the vault actually holds\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    function invariant_CallSummary() public view {\n        console.log(\"deposited      :\", handler.ghostDeposited());\n        console.log(\"withdrawn      :\", handler.ghostWithdrawn());\n        console.log(\"fees charged   :\", handler.ghostWithdrawFees());\n        console.log(\"aUSDT held     :\", aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console.log(\"ledger says    :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console.log(\"user claims sum:\", handler.totalUserClaims());\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

Same input, opposite outcome — which is the\n    ///         clearest single demonstration that the mock suite cannot vouch for this.\n    function test_F7_RealAaveRevertsOnTheDustWithdrawMockAllows() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 dust = 1e12 - 1;\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(dust), 0, \"worth zero assets\");\n\n        vm.expectRevert(bytes(\"26\")); // Errors.INVALID_AMOUNT\n        vault.withdraw(dust);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-6  Aave rounds the aToken mint down; the ledger does not\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2675,"cache_read_input_tokens":89091,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2675},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9f6217f-6077-4fe7-82ac-39ece15fcbf2","uuid":"6a873123-2b61-4f68-be69-48f665086146","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:47:28.645Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGfhJz3ZJmUivDF4bYw"}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9f6217f-6077-4fe7-82ac-39ece15fcbf2","uuid":"14d1051a-bb16-40f4-8e5c-93e78e88b6fe","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:47:28.665Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083652Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/test/fork/RealMainnetIntegration.t.sol","oldString":"    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-6  Aave rounds the aToken mint down; the ledger does not\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/","newString":"    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-7  Real Aave rejects the zero-amount withdrawal the mock allows\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault never checks that a withdrawal is worth more than zero.\n    ///         MockAavePool happily burns 0 and transfers 0; real Aave reverts with\n    ///         error 26 (INVALID_AMOUNT). Same input, opposite outcome — which is the\n    ///         clearest single demonstration that the mock suite cannot vouch for this.\n    function test_F7_RealAaveRevertsOnTheDustWithdrawMockAllows() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 dust = 1e12 - 1;\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(dust), 0, \"worth zero assets\");\n\n        vm.expectRevert(bytes(\"26\")); // Errors.INVALID_AMOUNT\n        vault.withdraw(dust);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-6  Aave rounds the aToken mint down; the ledger does not\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Reproduces the two candidate spellings of line 94 of UsdtYieldVault.sol\n///         in a separate call frame, so the revert is observable from the test.\ncontract ApproveProbe {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /// @dev Byte-for-byte what the vault does today.\n    function typedApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 value) external {\n        IERC20(token).approve(spender, value);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The proposed fix.\n    function safeApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 value) external {\n        IERC20(token).forceApprove(spender, value);\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Fork tests against the exact mainnet addresses this vault is meant to\n///         ship against. Nothing is mocked: real USDT, real Aave V3 pool, real aUSDT.\ncontract RealMainnetIntegrationTest is Test {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    // Addresses taken verbatim from README.md / the shipping plan.\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n    address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n\n    // Same Aave pool, but an asset whose approve() returns a bool. Used as the\n    // control group so we can separate \"USDT is special\" from \"Aave is broken\".\n    address internal constant USDC = 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48;\n    address internal constant AUSDC = 0x98C23E9d8f34FEFb1B7BD6a91B7FF122F4e16F5c;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        // Override with your own endpoint via MAINNET_RPC_URL if this one rate-limits.\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://eth.drpc.org\")), FORK_BLOCK);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  ROOT CAUSE: real USDT.approve() returns no return data\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Real USDT's approve() has no return value. A plain `IERC20.approve`\n    ///         call therefore fails ABI decoding and reverts.\n    function test_F1_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        (bool okUsdt, bytes memory retUsdt) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, 1));\n        console.log(\"USDT.approve  succeeded:\", okUsdt);\n        console.log(\"USDT.approve  returndata bytes:\", retUsdt.length);\n\n        (bool okUsdc, bytes memory retUsdc) = USDC.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, 1));\n        console.log(\"USDC.approve  succeeded:\", okUsdc);\n        console.log(\"USDC.approve  returndata bytes:\", retUsdc.length);\n\n        assertTrue(okUsdt, \"raw USDT approve should not revert\");\n        assertEq(retUsdt.length, 0, \"USDT returns nothing\");\n        assertEq(retUsdc.length, 32, \"a compliant token returns a bool\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Line 94 of UsdtYieldVault.sol in isolation: it reverts on real USDT,\n    ///         while the SafeERC20 spelling of the same line succeeds.\n    function test_F1_TypedApproveRevertsButForceApproveWorks() public {\n        ApproveProbe probe = new ApproveProbe();\n\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        probe.typedApprove(USDT, AAVE_POOL, 1e6);\n\n        probe.safeApprove(USDT, AAVE_POOL, 1e6);\n        assertEq(IERC20(USDT).allowance(address(probe), AAVE_POOL), 1e6, \"forceApprove sets the allowance\");\n\n        // Same typed call against a compliant token is fine, isolating the cause.\n        probe.typedApprove(USDC, AAVE_POOL, 1e6);\n        assertEq(IERC20(USDC).allowance(address(probe), AAVE_POOL), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-6  Aave rounds the aToken mint down; the ledger does not\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice totalAssetsStored credits the full deposit, but Aave mints slightly\n    ///         less than that. The vault's books claim more than it actually holds.\n    function test_F6_LedgerOverstatesTheRealAavePosition() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 100_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\n            vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n            console.log(\"deposit\", i + 1);\n            console.log(\"  totalAssetsStored :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n            console.log(\"  real aUSDC held   :\", IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        }\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertGt(\n            vault.totalAssetsStored(),\n            IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            \"ledger claims more than the vault holds\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  CONSEQUENCE: deposit() is unusable on mainnet\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Every deposit into the vault as configured for Monday reverts.\n    function test_F2_DepositAlwaysRevertsWithRealUsdt() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDT).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n\n        console.log(\"alice USDT balance:\", IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice));\n        console.log(\"vault allowance   :\", IERC20(USDT).allowance(alice, address(vault)));\n\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        // Nothing moved: the vault holds no position at all.\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Control group: identical vault bytecode, identical Aave pool, but an\n    ///         asset with a compliant approve(). It works. So the fault is the USDT\n    ///         integration in src/, not the Aave integration.\n    function test_F2_SameVaultWorksWithCompliantToken() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        console.log(\"shares minted            :\", shares);\n        console.log(\"vault aUSDC balance      :\", IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console.log(\"vault totalAssetsStored  :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  Aave interest is never credited to depositors\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault ignores its aToken balance, so a year of Aave interest is\n    ///         invisible to depositors and unreachable by anyone.\n    function test_F3_AaveInterestIsNeverCreditedAndIsStranded() public {\n        // Run on USDC so a deposit can actually land (see F-2). The accounting code\n        // under test is identical and asset-agnostic.\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 aTokenBefore = IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        uint256 aTokenAfter = IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"--- after 365 days in Aave ---\");\n        console.log(\"aToken balance before      :\", aTokenBefore);\n        console.log(\"aToken balance after       :\", aTokenAfter);\n        console.log(\"interest actually earned   :\", aTokenAfter - aTokenBefore);\n        console.log(\"vault.totalAssets()        :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console.log(\"alice balanceOfUnderlying  :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        console.log(\"vault.sharePrice()         :\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        // Aave really did pay interest.\n        assertGt(aTokenAfter, aTokenBefore, \"Aave paid interest\");\n\n        // The vault's books did not move one base unit.\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 10_000e6, \"totalAssets is frozen at the deposited amount\");\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), 10_000e6, \"alice's claim never grows\");\n\n        // Alice exits with everything she owns and receives none of the interest.\n        uint256 before = IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n        uint256 received = IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(alice) - before;\n\n        console.log(\"--- alice exits with all shares ---\");\n        console.log(\"USDC received              :\", received);\n        console.log(\"USDC deposited             :\", uint256(10_000e6));\n        console.log(\"vault totalShares now      :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console.log(\"vault totalAssetsStored now:\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console.log(\"aUSDC left in vault        :\", IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertLt(received, 10_000e6, \"she gets back less than she put in, after a year of yield\");\n\n        // Vault is now empty on its own books, yet still holds a real Aave position\n        // that no code path can ever reach.\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n        assertGt(IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"stranded forever\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":85,"oldLines":6,"newStart":85,"newLines":30,"lines":["     }"," ","     /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////","+        F-7  Real Aave rejects the zero-amount withdrawal the mock allows","+    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/","+","+    /// @notice The vault never checks that a withdrawal is worth more than zero.","+    ///         MockAavePool happily burns 0 and transfers 0; real Aave reverts with","+    ///         error 26 (INVALID_AMOUNT). Same input, opposite outcome — which is the","+    ///         clearest single demonstration that the mock suite cannot vouch for this.","+    function test_F7_RealAaveRevertsOnTheDustWithdrawMockAllows() public {","+        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);","+","+        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);","+        vm.startPrank(alice);","+        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);","+        vault.deposit(1_000e6);","+","+        uint256 dust = 1e12 - 1;","+        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(dust), 0, \"worth zero assets\");","+","+        vm.expectRevert(bytes(\"26\")); // Errors.INVALID_AMOUNT","+        vault.withdraw(dust);","+        vm.stopPrank();","+    }","+","+    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////","         F-6  Aave rounds the aToken mint down; the ledger does not","     //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGiiwnzGVvYfXJr7WaN","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GrbFpdHnQSMYKhfbCoFAj6","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083652Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/test/props/NegativeResults.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"../mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"../mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Attacks that were tried and do NOT work. These pass, and they are here so\n///         the report can distinguish \"checked and clean\" from \"not looked at\".\ncontract NegativeResultsTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal attacker = makeAddr(\"attacker\");\n    address internal victim = makeAddr(\"victim\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_FEE_BPS = 10; // the value the vault ships with\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), DEPOSIT_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(attacker, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(victim, 10_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice No ERC4626-style share inflation (\"donation\") attack. Because the vault\n    ///         prices shares off the `totalAssetsStored` counter rather than off its\n    ///         token balance, a direct transfer does not move the share price. The same\n    ///         stale accounting that causes F-3 happens to close this hole.\n    function test_Negative_DonationDoesNotInflateSharePrice() public {\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        vault.deposit(1e6);\n\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        // Donate 1,000,000 USDT straight to the vault.\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        usdt.transfer(address(vault), 999_999e6);\n\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), priceBefore, \"share price is immune to donations\");\n\n        // Victim's deposit mints the shares it should.\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        assertApproxEqRel(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(victim), 1_000e6, 0.001e18, \"victim not diluted\");\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n\n        // Note: the donated USDT is nonetheless permanently stuck (see F-5).\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 999_999e6);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A depositor cannot sandwich someone else's deposit to farm the deposit\n    ///         fee, because the 30 bps exit fee is larger than the 10 bps they can\n    ///         capture. This stops being true if the owner ever sets depositFeeBps\n    ///         above WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS.\n    function test_Negative_DepositFeeSandwichIsUnprofitable() public {\n        uint256 attackerStart = usdt.balanceOf(attacker);\n\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        uint256 attackerShares = vault.deposit(100_000e6); // front-run\n\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        vault.deposit(10_000_000e6); // the fat deposit being farmed\n\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        vault.withdraw(attackerShares); // back-run\n\n        uint256 attackerEnd = usdt.balanceOf(attacker);\n        console.log(\"attacker start :\", attackerStart);\n        console.log(\"attacker end   :\", attackerEnd);\n\n        assertLt(attackerEnd, attackerStart, \"sandwich loses money at the shipped fee levels\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A deposit/withdraw round trip can never return more than it put in, at\n    ///         any size. Rounding consistently favours the pool, not the caller.\n    function testFuzz_Negative_RoundTripIsNeverProfitable(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 500_000e6);\n\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(attacker);\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(amount);\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertLe(usdt.balanceOf(attacker), before, \"no free money out of the rounding\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Withdrawals cannot be used to drive the share price down and mint\n    ///         cheap shares: burning shares leaves the price exactly where it was.\n    function testFuzz_Negative_WithdrawalsDoNotMoveSharePrice(uint256 amount, uint256 burnPct) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1_000e6, 500_000e6);\n        burnPct = bound(burnPct, 1, 99);\n\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(amount);\n\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        vault.withdraw((shares * burnPct) / 100);\n\n        assertApproxEqAbs(vault.sharePrice(), priceBefore, 1, \"share price is flat across withdrawals\");\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3052,"cache_read_input_tokens":91766,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3052},"output_tokens":61,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9f6217f-6077-4fe7-82ac-39ece15fcbf2","uuid":"0853fb16-a5b0-4c7e-a104-e0ad2b2f053a","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:47:53.430Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGihPXyCE8K4h33KZe2"}

These pass, and they are here so\n///         the report can distinguish \"checked and clean\" from \"not looked at\".\ncontract NegativeResultsTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal attacker = makeAddr(\"attacker\");\n    address internal victim = makeAddr(\"victim\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT_FEE_BPS = 10; // the value the vault ships with\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), DEPOSIT_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(attacker, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(victim, 10_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice No ERC4626-style share inflation (\"donation\") attack. Because the vault\n    ///         prices shares off the `totalAssetsStored` counter rather than off its\n    ///         token balance, a direct transfer does not move the share price. The same\n    ///         stale accounting that causes F-3 happens to close this hole.\n    function test_Negative_DonationDoesNotInflateSharePrice() public {\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        vault.deposit(1e6);\n\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        // Donate 1,000,000 USDT straight to the vault.\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        usdt.transfer(address(vault), 999_999e6);\n\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), priceBefore, \"share price is immune to donations\");\n\n        // Victim's deposit mints the shares it should.\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        assertApproxEqRel(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(victim), 1_000e6, 0.001e18, \"victim not diluted\");\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n\n        // Note: the donated USDT is nonetheless permanently stuck (see F-5).\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 999_999e6);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A depositor cannot sandwich someone else's deposit to farm the deposit\n    ///         fee, because the 30 bps exit fee is larger than the 10 bps they can\n    ///         capture. This stops being true if the owner ever sets depositFeeBps\n    ///         above WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS.\n    function test_Negative_DepositFeeSandwichIsUnprofitable() public {\n        uint256 attackerStart = usdt.balanceOf(attacker);\n\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        uint256 attackerShares = vault.deposit(100_000e6); // front-run\n\n        vm.prank(victim);\n        vault.deposit(10_000_000e6); // the fat deposit being farmed\n\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        vault.withdraw(attackerShares); // back-run\n\n        uint256 attackerEnd = usdt.balanceOf(attacker);\n        console.log(\"attacker start :\", attackerStart);\n        console.log(\"attacker end   :\", attackerEnd);\n\n        assertLt(attackerEnd, attackerStart, \"sandwich loses money at the shipped fee levels\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A deposit/withdraw round trip can never return more than it put in, at\n    ///         any size. Rounding consistently favours the pool, not the caller.\n    function testFuzz_Negative_RoundTripIsNeverProfitable(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 500_000e6);\n\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(attacker);\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(amount);\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertLe(usdt.balanceOf(attacker), before, \"no free money out of the rounding\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Withdrawals cannot be used to drive the share price down and mint\n    ///         cheap shares: burning shares leaves the price exactly where it was.\n    function testFuzz_Negative_WithdrawalsDoNotMoveSharePrice(uint256 amount, uint256 burnPct) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1_000e6, 500_000e6);\n        burnPct = bound(burnPct, 1, 99);\n\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(amount);\n\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n        vm.prank(attacker);\n        vault.withdraw((shares * burnPct) / 100);\n\n        assertApproxEqAbs(vault.sharePrice(), priceBefore, 1, \"share price is flat across withdrawals\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CRzh2ncZu1bkVTtunWhTYy","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083652Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/test/fork/RealMainnetIntegration.t.sol has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9f6217f-6077-4fe7-82ac-39ece15fcbf2","uuid":"24105485-d565-4d15-a383-333036ca5b12","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:48:15.248Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083652Z-claude-with-skill-2/workspace/test/fork/RealMainnetIntegration.t.sol","oldString":"        vm.expectRevert(bytes(\"26\")); // Errors.INVALID_AMOUNT\n        vault.withdraw(dust);","newString":"        // Aave V3's Errors.InvalidAmount() — `cast sig \"InvalidAmount()\"` == 0x2c5211c6\n        vm.expectRevert(bytes4(0x2c5211c6));\n        vault.withdraw(dust);","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Reproduces the two candidate spellings of line 94 of UsdtYieldVault.sol\n///         in a separate call frame, so the revert is observable from the test.\ncontract ApproveProbe {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /// @dev Byte-for-byte what the vault does today.\n    function typedApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 value) external {\n        IERC20(token).approve(spender, value);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The proposed fix.\n    function safeApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 value) external {\n        IERC20(token).forceApprove(spender, value);\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Fork tests against the exact mainnet addresses this vault is meant to\n///         ship against. Nothing is mocked: real USDT, real Aave V3 pool, real aUSDT.\ncontract RealMainnetIntegrationTest is Test {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    // Addresses taken verbatim from README.md / the shipping plan.\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n    address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n\n    // Same Aave pool, but an asset whose approve() returns a bool. Used as the\n    // control group so we can separate \"USDT is special\" from \"Aave is broken\".\n    address internal constant USDC = 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48;\n    address internal constant AUSDC = 0x98C23E9d8f34FEFb1B7BD6a91B7FF122F4e16F5c;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 25_600_000;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        // Override with your own endpoint via MAINNET_RPC_URL if this one rate-limits.\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://eth.drpc.org\")), FORK_BLOCK);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  ROOT CAUSE: real USDT.approve() returns no return data\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Real USDT's approve() has no return value. A plain `IERC20.approve`\n    ///         call therefore fails ABI decoding and reverts.\n    function test_F1_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        (bool okUsdt, bytes memory retUsdt) = USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, 1));\n        console.log(\"USDT.approve  succeeded:\", okUsdt);\n        console.log(\"USDT.approve  returndata bytes:\", retUsdt.length);\n\n        (bool okUsdc, bytes memory retUsdc) = USDC.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", AAVE_POOL, 1));\n        console.log(\"USDC.approve  succeeded:\", okUsdc);\n        console.log(\"USDC.approve  returndata bytes:\", retUsdc.length);\n\n        assertTrue(okUsdt, \"raw USDT approve should not revert\");\n        assertEq(retUsdt.length, 0, \"USDT returns nothing\");\n        assertEq(retUsdc.length, 32, \"a compliant token returns a bool\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Line 94 of UsdtYieldVault.sol in isolation: it reverts on real USDT,\n    ///         while the SafeERC20 spelling of the same line succeeds.\n    function test_F1_TypedApproveRevertsButForceApproveWorks() public {\n        ApproveProbe probe = new ApproveProbe();\n\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        probe.typedApprove(USDT, AAVE_POOL, 1e6);\n\n        probe.safeApprove(USDT, AAVE_POOL, 1e6);\n        assertEq(IERC20(USDT).allowance(address(probe), AAVE_POOL), 1e6, \"forceApprove sets the allowance\");\n\n        // Same typed call against a compliant token is fine, isolating the cause.\n        probe.typedApprove(USDC, AAVE_POOL, 1e6);\n        assertEq(IERC20(USDC).allowance(address(probe), AAVE_POOL), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-7  Real Aave rejects the zero-amount withdrawal the mock allows\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault never checks that a withdrawal is worth more than zero.\n    ///         MockAavePool happily burns 0 and transfers 0; real Aave reverts with\n    ///         error 26 (INVALID_AMOUNT). Same input, opposite outcome — which is the\n    ///         clearest single demonstration that the mock suite cannot vouch for this.\n    function test_F7_RealAaveRevertsOnTheDustWithdrawMockAllows() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 dust = 1e12 - 1;\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(dust), 0, \"worth zero assets\");\n\n        vm.expectRevert(bytes(\"26\")); // Errors.INVALID_AMOUNT\n        vault.withdraw(dust);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-6  Aave rounds the aToken mint down; the ledger does not\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice totalAssetsStored credits the full deposit, but Aave mints slightly\n    ///         less than that. The vault's books claim more than it actually holds.\n    function test_F6_LedgerOverstatesTheRealAavePosition() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 100_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 5; i++) {\n            vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n            console.log(\"deposit\", i + 1);\n            console.log(\"  totalAssetsStored :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n            console.log(\"  real aUSDC held   :\", IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        }\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertGt(\n            vault.totalAssetsStored(),\n            IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            \"ledger claims more than the vault holds\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  CONSEQUENCE: deposit() is unusable on mainnet\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Every deposit into the vault as configured for Monday reverts.\n    function test_F2_DepositAlwaysRevertsWithRealUsdt() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDT).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n\n        console.log(\"alice USDT balance:\", IERC20(USDT).balanceOf(alice));\n        console.log(\"vault allowance   :\", IERC20(USDT).allowance(alice, address(vault)));\n\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        // Nothing moved: the vault holds no position at all.\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n        assertEq(IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Control group: identical vault bytecode, identical Aave pool, but an\n    ///         asset with a compliant approve(). It works. So the fault is the USDT\n    ///         integration in src/, not the Aave integration.\n    function test_F2_SameVaultWorksWithCompliantToken() public {\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        console.log(\"shares minted            :\", shares);\n        console.log(\"vault aUSDC balance      :\", IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)));\n        console.log(\"vault totalAssetsStored  :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  Aave interest is never credited to depositors\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault ignores its aToken balance, so a year of Aave interest is\n    ///         invisible to depositors and unreachable by anyone.\n    function test_F3_AaveInterestIsNeverCreditedAndIsStranded() public {\n        // Run on USDC so a deposit can actually land (see F-2). The accounting code\n        // under test is identical and asset-agnostic.\n        UsdtYieldVault vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDC, AUSDC, AAVE_POOL, 0, owner);\n\n        deal(USDC, alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(alice);\n        IERC20(USDC).forceApprove(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(10_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 aTokenBefore = IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        uint256 aTokenAfter = IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console.log(\"--- after 365 days in Aave ---\");\n        console.log(\"aToken balance before      :\", aTokenBefore);\n        console.log(\"aToken balance after       :\", aTokenAfter);\n        console.log(\"interest actually earned   :\", aTokenAfter - aTokenBefore);\n        console.log(\"vault.totalAssets()        :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console.log(\"alice balanceOfUnderlying  :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        console.log(\"vault.sharePrice()         :\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        // Aave really did pay interest.\n        assertGt(aTokenAfter, aTokenBefore, \"Aave paid interest\");\n\n        // The vault's books did not move one base unit.\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 10_000e6, \"totalAssets is frozen at the deposited amount\");\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), 10_000e6, \"alice's claim never grows\");\n\n        // Alice exits with everything she owns and receives none of the interest.\n        uint256 before = IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n        uint256 received = IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(alice) - before;\n\n        console.log(\"--- alice exits with all shares ---\");\n        console.log(\"USDC received              :\", received);\n        console.log(\"USDC deposited             :\", uint256(10_000e6));\n        console.log(\"vault totalShares now      :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console.log(\"vault totalAssetsStored now:\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console.log(\"aUSDC left in vault        :\", IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)));\n\n        assertLt(received, 10_000e6, \"she gets back less than she put in, after a year of yield\");\n\n        // Vault is now empty on its own books, yet still holds a real Aave position\n        // that no code path can ever reach.\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0);\n        assertGt(IERC20(AUSDC).balanceOf(address(vault)), 0, \"stranded forever\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":103,"oldLines":7,"newStart":103,"newLines":8,"lines":["         uint256 dust = 1e12 - 1;","         assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(dust), 0, \"worth zero assets\");"," ","-        vm.expectRevert(bytes(\"26\")); // Errors.INVALID_AMOUNT","+        // Aave V3's Errors.InvalidAmount() — `cast sig \"InvalidAmount()\"` == 0x2c5211c6","+        vm.expectRevert(bytes4(0x2c5211c6));","         vault.withdraw(dust);","         vm.stopPrank();","     }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}
